question: Allow BFSI customers to reset their password via an OTP sent to their registered email.
ground_truth: As a registered customer, I want to reset my password via a time-limited OTP sent to my registered email so that I can regain account access securely without contacting support.

question: Enable a relationship manager to view a consolidated dashboard of all loans held by a customer across branches.
ground_truth: As a relationship manager, I want a consolidated cross-branch view of a customer's loans so that I can assess total exposure before approving new credit.

question: Business users must be able to download account statements in PDF for any date range within the last five years.
ground_truth: As an account holder, I want to download my statement as PDF for any range in the last five years so that I have a portable record for tax and dispute purposes.

question: A compliance officer needs to freeze a suspicious account instantly and see the freeze reflected in all channels.
ground_truth: As a compliance officer, I want to freeze an account with one action and have every channel enforce it immediately so that fraudulent activity is stopped without delay.

question: Customers should be able to set up recurring international transfers with per-day FX limits.
ground_truth: As an international remittance customer, I want recurring transfers with daily FX caps so that regular overseas payments happen automatically within my risk limits.

question: Tellermasters at branches need an offline mode that queues transactions when the network drops and syncs on restore.
ground_truth: As a branch teller, I want transactions queued offline and synced automatically so that customer service continues during network outages.

question: Allow auditors to export immutable audit trails for any entity in signed CSV.
ground_truth: As an internal auditor, I want to export a signed, immutable audit trail for any entity so that I can present tamper-evident evidence to regulators.

question: Onboarding must capture KYC documents with automated quality checks before submission.
ground_truth: As an onboarding agent, I want KYC uploads validated for legibility and completeness before submission so that rework cycles are avoided.

question: The system shall validate IBAN numbers for SEPA transfers and reject invalid ones before any fee is charged.
ground_truth: Given a SEPA transfer with a structurally invalid IBAN, when submitted, then it is rejected with error code IBAN_INVALID and no fee is charged. Given a valid IBAN, when submitted, then processing continues. Given an IBAN valid in format but unmapped to a participating country, then rejected with COUNTRY_UNSUPPORTED.

question: Password reset OTP must expire in 5 minutes and allow three verification attempts.
ground_truth: Given an OTP issued, when used after 5 minutes, then rejected as expired. Given three failed attempts, when a fourth occurs, then the reset flow locks and restarts. Given a correct OTP within limits, then the password is changed and all sessions are revoked.

question: Account freeze must take effect in every channel within 30 seconds of the officer's action.
ground_truth: Given a freeze issued, when any channel attempts a debit within 30 seconds, then it is declined with reason code ACCOUNT_FROZEN. Given the freeze, when the officer queries status after propagation, then it reports ACTIVE across all channels. Freeze action is logged immutably with actor and timestamp.

question: Statement download must support date ranges up to 60 months and enforce a daily cap of 20 downloads per customer.
ground_truth: Given a range longer than 60 months, then request is rejected with RANGE_TOO_LONG. Given the 21st download in a calendar day, then throttled with LIMIT_EXCEEDED and an audit event. Given a valid range, then a watermark-secured PDF matching the ledger for that period is returned.

question: KYC document upload must verify document type matches the declared category and reject blurred images.
ground_truth: Given a passport upload declared as ID proof, when submitted, then accepted after machine-readable zone check. Given a blurred image below the sharpness threshold, then rejected with QUALITY_TOO_LOW and a re-capture prompt. Given a document type mismatch, then rejected with CATEGORY_MISMATCH.

question: Recurring FX transfers must never exceed the customer's configured per-day limit across all mandates combined.
ground_truth: Given mandates totalling the daily FX limit, when a further transfer is scheduled that day, then it is deferred to the next value date with a customer notification. Given a limit change, then it applies to future executions only. Combined same-day execution never exceeds the cap.

question: Offline teller queue must preserve transaction ordering and replay idempotently after connectivity restore.
ground_truth: Given queued transactions, when connectivity returns, then they replay in capture order with no duplicates. Given a transaction already recorded centrally, when replayed, then it is recognised by idempotency key and not double-posted. Given queue capacity exhaustion, then teller is warned before capture.

question: Verify the SEPA transfer IBAN validation behaviour for edge inputs.
ground_truth: TC-1: valid German DE89... IBAN, expect pass. TC-2: unknown country prefix XX, expect COUNTRY_UNSUPPORTED. TC-3: checksum digit tampered, expect IBAN_INVALID, no fee ledger entry. TC-4: 35-char upper/lowercase mix, expect normalised accept. TC-5: 1,000 concurrent requests, expect p95 validation latency under 200 ms.

question: Design test coverage for the OTP password reset journey including abuse paths.
ground_truth: Positive: correct OTP changes password, sessions revoked. Negative: expired OTP at 5m01s rejected; 4th attempt locks flow; wrong OTP for non-existent user returns generic message (no enumeration). Security: replay of used OTP rejected; brute force triggers CAPTCHA. Boundary: reset exactly at 5m00s accepted.

question: Test the account freeze propagation SLA across channels.
ground_truth: Given freeze at T0, when debit via mobile/ATM/counter at T0+15s, then all decline with ACCOUNT_FROZEN. When debit attempted at T0+45s against a stale channel cache, then still declined (cache bypassed for frozen list). Verify audit trail contains propagation timestamps per channel. Negative: unfreeze by non-authorised role rejected 403.

question: Create regression tests for statement PDF generation performance and correctness.
ground_truth: Generate PDF for max 60-month range, expect under 8s and page count matches transaction volume. Verify totals reconcile with ledger extract. Empty range yields PDF with NO_DATA banner, not error. Watermark and customer identifier present on every page. 20-download cap yields LIMIT_EXCEEDED on 21st.

question: Define acceptance tests for KYC quality gates.
ground_truth: Fixture set: 200 real-document samples. Expect blurred samples rejected with QUALITY_TOO_LOW, passport-as-national-ID rejected with CATEGORY_MISMATCH, clean matches accepted with MZ checksum verified. False-rejection rate under 5%. Each decision recorded with model confidence.

question: Test idempotency of the offline teller sync replay.
ground_truth: Queue 50 transactions, force two overlapping sync attempts, expect 50 ledger posts exactly once; duplicates matched by idempotency key and acknowledged as already posted. Kill mid-sync, restart, expect resumption without loss. Ordering preserved across replay.

question: Verify FX daily limit aggregation across multiple standing mandates.
ground_truth: Three mandates of 400/400/300 EUR under 1000 limit: same-day executions total 1000, the 4th defers with notification. Mid-day limit raise to 1500 allows next execution. All deferrals logged and visible in customer portal within 60 seconds.

question: Specify the API contract for requesting and confirming an email OTP password reset.
ground_truth: POST /auth/password-reset/request {email} -> 202 generic receipt (no user enumeration); 429 on rate limit. POST /auth/password-reset/confirm {token, new_password, confirm_password} -> 200 with sessions_revoked true; 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED or TOKEN_INVALID; 422 WEAK_PASSWORD with policy details. Errors documented: 400 invalid payload, 429 too-many-requests, 500 upstream.

question: Design the account freeze endpoints for compliance officers.
ground_truth: POST /accounts/{id}/freeze {reason_code, authorised_by} role=compliance -> 201 {freeze_id, propagation_deadline}; GET /accounts/{id}/freeze-status -> {state: ACTIVE|PENDING, channels: [{channel, ack_at}]}; DELETE /accounts/{id}/freeze requires dual-control header. Errors: 403 insufficient role, 404 account unknown, 409 already frozen.

question: Specify statement download API with streaming PDF and range validation.
ground_truth: GET /accounts/{id}/statements?from=YYYY-MM-01&to=YYYY-MM-DD -> 200 application/pdf (chunked); 400 RANGE_TOO_LONG for spans over 60 months; 403 cross-account without relationship; 429 LIMIT_EXCEEDED after 20/day. Response includes X-Statement-Checksum and X-Rate-Remaining headers.

question: Define the recurring FX transfer mandate API.
ground_truth: POST /fx/mandates {creditor_iban, amount, currency, frequency, start_date} -> 201 {mandate_id, next_execution}; PATCH /fx/mandates/{id} {daily_limit} applies prospectively; GET /fx/mandates/{id}/executions?period -> list with status EXECUTED|DEFERRED_LIMIT and notification_sent flag. 422 for limit below single amount.

question: Design KYC upload endpoints returning quality decisions.
ground_truth: POST /kyc/sessions/{sid}/documents multipart {file, declared_category} -> 201 {document_id, decision: ACCEPTED|REJECTED, reason_code, confidence}; supported png/jpg/pdf up to 15MB -> 415/413 otherwise. GET /kyc/sessions/{sid} aggregates all decisions with completeness score for submission gate.

question: Describe the architecture for multi-channel account freeze enforcement.
ground_truth: Freeze service writes to an append-only freeze ledger (Postgres) and publishes a change event on Kafka; a Redis-backed frozen-accounts filter is updated by a consumer with 5s SLA; every channel (mobile BFF, ATM switch, teller) checks the filter pre-authorisation and falls back to the ledger on cache miss; reconciliation job re-pushes un-acked entries; all propagation timestamps audited.

question: Outline the architecture for offline teller capture with central replay.
ground_truth: Teller client keeps an encrypted local SQLite journal with monotonic sequence numbers; on connectivity it pushes batches to /teller/sync with idempotency keys; the sync service de-duplicates against the ledger, replays in order, and emits per-item ACKs; journal compacts after full ACK; keys derive from branch-bound hardware tokens; supervisory queue-depth alerts on backlog.

question: Architecture for KYC ingestion with automated quality gates.
ground_truth: API gateway -> object store (signed URLs, immutable) -> doc-quality worker (vision model + OCR + MZ checksum) writes decision to KYC store; rules engine applies per-product document matrix; submission gate blocks until required set passes; human-review queue for low-confidence; decision events feed audit trail; PII encrypted at rest with per-customer keys.

question: Design the statement generation architecture for five-year ranges.
ground_truth: Statement service queries the ledger read-replica per month shard; PDF renderer assembles pages with watermarking library from a template service; large requests are queued with a job endpoint returning job id, completed jobs cached for 24h; cap counter in Redis per customer-day; horizontal autoscaling of renderers with p95 target under 8s for one year.

question: Describe the SEPA payment validation pipeline architecture.
ground_truth: Payments API validates IBAN format and checksum statelessly, then country-support via hot config cache; fee service charges only post-validation commit through a two-phase ledger entry; throttling per customer in Redis; validation events published for fraud scoring; degradation path fails open for fraud but never for validation.

question: Plan delivery of the OTP password reset capability.
ground_truth: Sprint 1: token issuance and verification service with expiry/attempt limits, generic responses for enumeration defence, tests. Sprint 2: email channel integration, rate limiting, session revocation, abuse-path tests, load test, canary rollout with freeze switch.

question: Plan the multi-channel account freeze rollout.
ground_truth: Sprint 1: freeze ledger, compliance API with dual-control unfreeze, Kafka event contract, unit and contract tests. Sprint 2: Redis filter consumer and channel SDKs, propagation SLA dashboards, chaos test for stale cache, pilot branch then bank-wide rollout.

question: Plan KYC onboarding quality gates delivery.
ground_truth: Sprint 1: upload API, object store with signed URLs, document matrix rules for two products, decision audit events. Sprint 2: quality model integration with confidence thresholds, human-review queue, submission gate, false-rejection tuning on 200-sample fixture set.

question: Plan offline teller capture capability.
ground_truth: Sprint 1: encrypted local journal, sequence numbering, queue-depth UI warnings. Sprint 2: sync service with idempotency keys, overlapping replay tests, branch pilot at three sites, supervisory alerts and runbook.

question: Plan recurring international transfers with FX limits.
ground_truth: Sprint 1: mandate CRUD with prospective limit semantics, execution scheduler, notification contract. Sprint 2: daily aggregation across mandates with deferral queue, portal visibility within 60s, regulator-facing deferral report, staged country rollout.

question: Fraud analysts need real-time alerts when a card is used in two countries within an impossible travel window.
ground_truth: As a fraud analyst, I want an alert when the same card is used in two countries within an impossible travel window so that I can block the card before further loss.

question: Verify impossible-travel fraud detection thresholds.
ground_truth: Given EU usage then 2 hours later US usage, expect HIGH-RISK alert and auto-block per policy. Given 10h gap with connecting hub, expect score under threshold and no block. Alert contains both transactions, MCC, and confidence; analyst override recorded in audit; 100k-event replay completes in under 5 minutes.

question: Card loss reported via mobile app must instantly decline in-store contactless while online PAN use needs step-up.
ground_truth: Given a loss report, when contactless in-store occurs within 10 seconds, then declined LOST_CARD. Given online PAN usage, then 3DS step-up offered, not blanket decline. Report is immutable; restoration requires officer approval; all events auditable per card.

question: Specify the card block/restore endpoints for fraud analysts.
ground_truth: POST /cards/{token}/block {reason_code} analyst role -> 200 {state: BLOCKED, effective_at}; DELETE requires dual-control + ticket id, 403 if missing; GET /cards/{token}/events returns reason timeline with actor. Errors: 404 unknown token, 409 already blocked, 422 invalid reason_code.

question: Describe the stream architecture for real-time fraud scoring.
ground_truth: Authorisation events to Kafka; scoring Flink job joins 30-day behaviour per card, applies impossible-travel and MCC heuristics with model confidence; alerts written to analyst queue and decision store; hot config for thresholds versioned; late events reconciled in batch; exactly-once via checkpointing.

question: Plan card fraud real-time alerting delivery.
ground_truth: Sprint 1: Kafka event contract, heuristics-only scoring, alert queue with analyst workflow, replay tests. Sprint 2: behaviour features, block/restore APIs with dual control, threshold dashboards, shadow-mode scoring for two weeks before auto-block enablement.

question: SME customers should receive a pre-approved credit limit offer based on 12 months of account inflows.
ground_truth: As an SME owner, I want a pre-approved credit limit from twelve months of inflow history so that I can access working capital without a full manual underwrite.

question: SME inflow scoring must exclude related-party transfers and refresh monthly.
ground_truth: Given 12 months history, related-party inflows are excluded from the score with an itemisation visible to the analyst. Monthly refresh adjusts limits, never auto-reduces within 30 days without notice. Score recomputes deterministically for the same window.

question: Test related-party exclusion in SME limit scoring.
ground_truth: Synthetic ledger with 40% related-party inflows, expect excluded component in itemisation and limit from 60% eligible base. Duplicate transfer pairs across windows counted once. Boundary months with one eligible inflow handled per policy floor. Analyst itemisation totals reconcile to the score.

question: Design the SME offer acceptance flow API.
ground_truth: GET /sme/{cid}/offer -> {limit, tenor, basis_summary} or 404 NO_OFFER; POST /sme/{cid}/offer/accept with consent_version -> 201 {facility_id}; decline returns to cooling period (30 days) 410 OFFER_WITHDRAWN when stale; all consent records versioned for audit.

question: Outline the data architecture for monthly SME limit recomputation.
ground_truth: Ledger CDC feed to the analytics lake; per-customer eligible-inflow aggregate rebuilt monthly with feature versioning; rules engine applies product policy producing deterministic limit with basis trace; publish only on material change (>10%); full history of runs kept for regulator sampling.

question: Plan the audit trail export capability for regulators.
ground_truth: Sprint 1: signed CSV writer over the immutable event store with entity filters, redaction rules per jurisdiction, download audit entries. Sprint 2: scheduled regulator bundles, hash-chain verification tooling, 200-entity scale test, and documentation with a sample signed export for the demo.

question: Specify the internal event-bus contract for account lifecycle events.
ground_truth: Publish topic accounts.lifecycle v2 {event_id, account_id, event_type: OPENED|FROZEN|THAWED|CLOSED, occurred_at, actor, reason_code}; consumer contract: idempotent by event_id, ordering per account_id partition; schema evolution additive-only with deprecation windows; DLQ with 24h replay tooling.
